**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner incorrectly concluded that Curtis Bernhardt (born April 15, 1899) was younger than Emile Ardolino (born May 9, 1943). This error stems from a misinterpretation of basic date comparison. This error aligns with misinterpretation of chronological relationships, a logical inconsistency pattern seen in similar cases.
